fields.name: alias
fields.description: Sets an alias for multiple instances of the same input plugin.

fields.name: database_file
fields.description: Specify a database file to keep track of processed files and their state.

fields.name: exclude_pattern
fields.description: Set one or multiple shell patterns separated by commas to exclude files matching certain criteria.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Specifies the log level for this input plugin.

fields.name: log_suppress_interval
fields.description: Suppresses log messages from this input plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval.

fields.name: mem_buf_limit
fields.description: Set a memory buffer limit for the input plugin instance in bytes.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Path to scan for blob (binary) files.

fields.name: routable
fields.description: If true, the data generated by the plugin can be forwarded to other plugins or outputs.

fields.name: scan_refresh_interval
fields.description: Set the interval time to scan for new files.

fields.name: storage.pause_on_chunks_overlimit
fields.description: Enable pausing on an input when it reaches its chunks limit.

fields.name: storage.type
fields.description: Sets the storage type for this input.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Set a tag for the events generated by this input plugin.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

fields.name: thread.ring_buffer.capacity
fields.description: Set custom ring buffer capacity when the input runs in threaded mode.

fields.name: thread.ring_buffer.window
fields.description: Set custom ring buffer window percentage for threaded inputs.

fields.name: upload_failure_action
fields.description: Action to perform on the file after upload failure.

fields.name: upload_failure_message
fields.description: Message to emit as a log record after upload failure.

fields.name: upload_failure_suffix
fields.description: Suffix to append to the filename after upload failure.

fields.name: upload_success_action
fields.description: Action to perform on the file after successful upload.

fields.name: upload_success_message
fields.description: Message to emit as a log record after successful upload.

fields.name: upload_success_suffix
fields.description: Suffix to append to the filename after successful upload.
